targets.title: ✦INTRADAY TRADER✦ Trading: the only job where you do everything right and still lose 🔥
targets.author: Intraday trader
targets.text:
Trading psychology for beginners: why you can follow every rule in intraday trading and still take a loss, and how to handle it.
Trading is the only profession where you can do everything right and still lose. A good setup can fail, and a perfect plan can still hit your stop loss. That is normal. This video is for every intraday trader who wants to understand that one loss does not mean a bad strategy, and that long-term results come from probabilities and discipline.
How to handle losses like a pro:
✦ Accept that losses are part of trading
✦ Judge your process, not a single trade
